messages.text: Could you make a poster and a matching reel for our night market, please? I’m excited about sharing this because the market is something I’ve really been looking forward to. The poster should be vertical, and the matching reel should be 8 seconds long, with both saying “Night Market”, “Saturday 12 July”, “6–10 pm”, “Riverside Yard”, and “Free entry”. For the look, I’d like warm illustrated food stalls and string lights. Please keep all the details readable throughout the reel, with a little animation behind them, and no sound.

text:
Your poster and reel are ready.

**Poster** (vertical 9:16, warm illustrated food stalls and string lights):
https://videos.magichour.ai/cmwbhzm9401vuhb011gbzhjny/output-0.png?X-Goog-Algorithm=GOOG4-RSA-SHA256&X-Goog-Credential=web-service%40magic-hour-385504.iam.gserviceaccount.com%2F20261111%2Fauto%2Fstorage%2Fgoog4_request&X-Goog-Date=20261111T022631Z&X-Goog-Expires=86400&X-Goog-SignedHeaders=host&X-Goog-

**Reel** (vertical, 8 seconds, no sound):
http://127.0.0.1:8000/films/6ceabce2ddc3493fad2b92b48c566a3e.mp4

How I made the reel: a video model can scramble words while it animates them. So I first made a still image of the same scene with all five lines on it ("Night Market", "Saturday 12 July", "6–10 pm", "Riverside Yard", "Free entry"). Then I animated that still with a fixed camera and gentle motion behind the text: the string lights twinkle and sway, steam rises from the stalls and the lanterns glow. I checked the length (8 s), the shape (vertical) and the sound (none), and all three are right.

Two things to know:
- I couldn't preview the pictures from here, so please check the spelling of all five lines on the poster and through the whole reel before you share them. If anything is wrong, tell me and I'll redo it.
- The reel's opening frame was drawn separately from the poster. It has the same look and the same words, but the layout isn't identical. If you want the reel to be the poster itself in motion, I can animate the poster image instead.

Both are at the free plan size (640px poster, 480p reel). The links work for about 24 hours, so download them soon.
